executiveSummary: This period saw multiple high-impact criminal and enforcement developments. Microsoft and partners disrupted the EvilTokens phishing-as-a-service platform after it reportedly compromised more than 12,000 Microsoft accounts across over 10,000 organizations, demonstrating AI-enhanced phishing and BEC at scale Source . Separately, a regulator-notified breach in Spain was described as the first known "agentic AI" data breach, where an AI agent allegedly chained intrusion steps autonomously-an escalation in AI-enabled offensive capability View Article . Law enforcement pursued large-scale actions against nonconsensual deepfake pornography networks, including a Manhattan operation seizing 12 domains affecting more than 1,200 victims Source , and a DOJ seizure of cross-border deepfake sites under the TAKE IT DOWN Act View Article . Courts also imposed a lengthy sentence in a case involving AI-generated CSAM, underscoring prosecutorial momentum Source . Defensive and policy signals include Anthropic's rollout of Content Credentials and text marking Source , media-industry provenance/detection collaborations View Article , and Android protections against AI deepfake scam calls Source . Governments signaled potential cross-border AI incident notification mechanisms Source . Overall, the threat environment appears to be worsening: large-scale AI-enabled phishing and BEC, the emergence of agentic AI in breaches, and persistent deepfake abuse outweigh incremental defensive gains and policy proposals Supporting Report .

Email/BEC Defense: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA; monitor OAuth grants and token issuance; block legacy auth; implement conditional access and anomaly-based session revocation. [Analyst Recommendation]
Mailbox Forensics: Hunt for conversation hijacking, auto-forwarding, mailbox rules, and vendor bank detail changes; verify out-of-band prior to payment changes. [Analyst Recommendation]
Agentic AI Threats: Add detections for autonomous task schedulers, unusual API automation bursts, and cross-service orchestration patterns at machine speed. [Analyst Recommendation]
Media Provenance: Adopt C2PA/Content Credentials where available; archive original capture metadata; preserve watermark chains through production/distribution. [Analyst Recommendation]
Voice Scam Mitigation: Train staff and families on "safe words," callback verification, and delaying transfers; telecoms should flag high-risk call patterns. [Analyst Recommendation]
Legal Readiness: Update evidence handling SOPs for AI-generated media, including prompt logs, generation artifacts, and model/version capture. [Analyst Recommendation]
